statements: `permission_prompt` fires only when a permission UI is actually waiting. The matcher tests the real tool name; MCP calls routed through the internal `use_tool` / Cursor `CallMcpTool` dispatchers appear as the qualified `server__tool` name (e.g. `linear__save_issue`), so match on that, not the dispatcher name.
Its `message` is display text and can change between releases, so match on `notificationType` instead.
current_mapper: normalize reads notificationType; notification case emits generic notification except idle_prompt unknown state
